notes: Source mismatch: the catalog text is the page for English (AA-T), an Associate in Arts for Transfer, not Liberal Arts and Sciences: Literature and Languages (A.A. Degree). The text contains no section for the named award, so no blocks, total, GE pattern or outcomes were recorded. section_heading names the only program section on the page, which was not used for this award.

The English (AA-T) section prints its own Program Student Learning Outcomes, a Required Core with Option 1/Option 2, Lists A, B and C, and a total of 19-21 units with Cal-GETC. None of this was attributed to the Literature and Languages A.A., since nothing in the text says that award shares these requirements or outcomes.
A reviewer should locate the Cerritos College 2026-2027 catalog page for Liberal Arts and Sciences: Literature and Languages (A.A.) and rerun the extraction against it.

Many closed-list courses (ASL, CHIN, ENGL, FILM 241, FREN, GERM, JAPN, SPAN) appear in the English (AA-T) lists. The others (ANTH 100, ANTH 170, ART 108, ART 109, FILM 159, GERM 203, GERM 204, GERM 281-283, HUM 108, HUM 109, KOR 101, KOR 102) do not appear anywhere in the text.
